name: @certrev/cert-block
description: Headless / crypto_verify render edge for the CertREV CertDeliveryEnvelope. SSR-safe React components (<CertBadge>/<ExpertBio>/<CertRevBacklink>), a deterministic schema.org JSON-LD projector, a fail-closed verify layer over the shared VerdictKernel, and a framework-agnostic <certrev-badge> Web Component. Sign once (portal), render everywhere (Hydrogen / Next / Builder / universal embed).

scripts.build:modal-bundle: pnpm dlx esbuild@0.27.7 src/modal/certrev-cert.entry.ts --bundle --minify --target=es2020 --format=iife --legal-comments=none --tsconfig-raw='{"compilerOptions":{"target":"ES2017","module":"esnext","strict":true}}' --banner:js='/* biome-ignore-all format: generated cert-badge bundle, see @certrev/cert-block src/modal/ */ /* biome-ignore-all lint: generated cert-badge bundle, see @certrev/cert-block src/modal/ */' --outfile=dist/modal/certrev-cert.js
